stem: A crop that previously reached the supplied next-irrigation moisture condition in two days now reaches it in one day as canopy size and light increase. What should the technician do?
choices: Assume the old irrigation interval must remain unchanged
Document the faster dryback trend and escalate for schedule review according to procedure
Add a second container of media to every plant
rationale: Plant demand and environment can change water use. A measured shift in dryback should be documented and used to inform authorized irrigation-schedule review.
